scoring_arithmetic: Python float(original stored objective) minus float(actual weighted component); use original component when stored and parity verified, otherwise exact original function reconstruction. No rounding or tie tolerance.

paths.G10_ONLY: rerank each original G10 retained-feasible pool using original backend comparator, choose accepted family by modified winner objective and original family index; return that family original G13 output unchanged
paths.G13_INTERNAL_ONLY: keep original G10 family fixed; rerank only its original G13 retained-feasible pool; original no-candidate/fallback output unchanged

unknown_cost_policy: do not perform or claim the affected rank-influence diagnostic; retain full cohort denominators and reason
reference_role: posthoc diagnosis only, not independent selector performance
